source_summary: Ink-and-light-color Chinese waterside landscape with framing cliffs, misty rolling hills, sparse spring trees, a small boat with two figures, a foreground pavilion, willow and rocky banks. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif extraction.

motifs.name: left_cliff_spring_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left vertical cliff face with the cluster of bare-branched spring trees growing against it, including the dark ink trunks, dotted moss, pale blue-green leaf washes, and the grey vertical cliff washes. Exclude the inscription area above and any central hills beyond the cliff edge.
must_preserve: ragged vertical grey wash texture of the cliff
dark dotted moss accents along rock edges
heavy dark trunk bases and exposed root-like strokes

motifs.name: mid_distance_rolling_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal chain of rounded mid-distance hills and rocky banks across the upper middle water, including the layered grey washes, small rock outcrops, dotted shrub textures, and soft mist gaps. Exclude calligraphy and seals above, and exclude the boat below.
must_preserve: black dotted shrub clusters along ridgelines
pale misty edges where hills meet water

motifs.name: right_cliff_bare_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the upper-right rock ledge and cliff mass with the tall bare trees and dotted shrubs. Include the overhanging grey rock washes, dark bark strokes, sparse twig networks, and moss dots. Exclude the red seal at far right and the boat below.
must_preserve: rounded boulder forms under the cliff lip
black moss dots and shrub clusters
soft pale blue background wash behind branches

motifs.name: narrow_boat_two_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the slender skiff with two seated figures on the water, including the boat ribs, pointed prow and stern, thin water ripples, black figure outlines, and red-orange clothing accents. Exclude adjacent cliff and tree trunks.
must_preserve: two seated figures with black ink contours
light empty-water space immediately around the boat

motifs.name: foreground_pavilion_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground lakeside pavilion and its rocky bank, including the tiled roof geometry, posts, railing, steps, adjacent stones, and dark ink architectural lines. Keep only the pavilion group and immediate ground; exclude the tall willow and unrelated open water.
must_preserve: slanted tiled roof with repeated parallel tile strokes
short steps or small landing beside the building
rounded bank rocks with grey wash
black moss-dot accents around the foundation

motifs.name: central_leafless_saplings
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground grove of thin leafless saplings rising in front of the pavilion area, with some faint blue-green foliage haze behind them. Include the branching ink skeletons and overlapping slender trunks, but exclude the pavilion roof and willow fronds where possible.
must_preserve: varied ink weight from pale grey twigs to dark trunks
subtle blue-green wash patches behind branches
interlaced lower twigs and dark base strokes

motifs.name: leaning_willow_clump
motifs.description: Isolate the leaning willow at the lower center-right with its arcing trunk, drooping fronds, and surrounding reed-like grasses. Include the brownish trunk accent, grey-black hanging leaf strokes, and nearby soft rock base, while excluding the pavilion and distant islands.
must_preserve: curving leaning trunk with warm brown accent
small rounded stones at the root area

motifs.name: right_low_islets_waterline
motifs.description: Isolate the low rocky islets and horizontal water bands in the lower-right distance. Include the shallow shoreline rocks, dark moss dots, low grey washes, and thin horizontal ripple lines. Exclude the willow branches above and the blank paper around the seal area.
must_preserve: black moss-dot clusters on rock tops
misty separation between islands and water
subtle tonal gradation along the shoreline

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
